thesis: The episode discusses the current market environment where value stocks are not cheap on an absolute basis relative to their long-run averages, even though they appear cheap relative to growth alternatives like the 10-year Treasury. The speakers note that while value seems to be having a run, this may actually be a rally in small, cheap, and junk stocks rather than high-quality value, which complicates the investment thesis.
